items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: And Handy was in the place with it. That man arranged with the symphonic parade in St. Louis Blues.

ctx.x: It's almost all on there, I think.

St. Louis Blues. They got a big symphonic arrangement with all those strings and trumpets. And pops came on there like a champ. Different movements. That man played. And when they got through with it, this man's dedicated. He said, ladies and gentlemen, he said, we just heard, he says, Lewis always said that he wanted to play with the symphony. He says, we are honored to have this man with us because he's such an artist that when he's practicing, when he makes one note, he's such an inspiration, which it is. Pop…
